not insured:
1€ for less than 8 cards
2€ for up to 20 cards
4€ for more

insured:
6€ for less than 32 cards
1€ for each 10 cards more

If shipment is done without insurance, no reimbursment in case of loss
If shipment is done with insurance, it is reimbursed in case of loss
